assets.name: mob-sonic
assets.prompt: Create one new sibling character by transforming the supplied MOB mascot references. References 1 and 2 define the SAME SERIES: chibi cartoon pixel art, black cat-ear hoodie with colored inner-ear piping, deep black face inside hood, oversized expressive eyes in round GOLD spectacle rims, a gold stripe on hood, small chunky gloves, baggy shorts and large sneakers. Preserve this recognizable design language and chunky crisp pixel-cluster shading, approximately two-heads-tall proportions. These are NOT realistic humans. Full body, entire silhouette and prop visible, centered with generous transparent margin. One character only, clean isolated genuine transparent PNG background. No lettering, no labels, no watermark, no frame, no scenery. Polished finished game character illustration, matching the references' pixel-art density and outline thickness. MOB SONIC: sports-loving energetic roller skater. Vivid electric teal and lime accent piping on black cat-eared hoodie, gold-rimmed lively turquoise eyes. In a dynamic low skating pose with one roller skate forward and one kicking back, clearly visible small skate wheels. Short pixelated translucent cyan afterimage trails behind arms and skates, conveying great speed, but not duplicate bodies and not obscuring silhouette. Must remain a MOB hooded mascot, not Sonic the Hedgehog.

A few green leaves on branch; include the complete branch and complete dangling cat with generous margins. Playful and mischievous, not scary. Keep ring-pattern eyes obvious. Genuinely transparent background around branch and character, no scenery, no words, no border.
